reading_note: The single arc: how the natural mind is formed as a five-fold receptacle by self-love and falsity, yet bears the imprint of divine truth; how each sensory degree functions as a storehouse where affections gather and yield up their stored images on demand; how the heart's affection rules these five as a king rules his city; and how the Mind of Light (the regenerating truth from the Lord) must come as a stranger to these gates, humble the archonic guards that opened them only to desire, vain care, and defiled appetite, and seize the keys so that the whole body of the natural man is governed from above rather than from below.
